conglomerate-outcrop.effective: Selected clasts have smaller exposed caps and more varied embed depth; matrix continuity and original cut face retained. No new geometry/material cost.
conglomerate-outcrop.ineffective_or_limited: Only six outer clasts changed. Whole-object bead/stud impression and original simplified host shape remain; normal-size and native 240px improvement is slight, not a demonstrated clear upgrade.
conglomerate-outcrop.disposition: Keep as optional A/B candidate; no replacement recommendation on this evidence alone.

horsetail-cluster.effective: Three branch tips can change direction/length without losing root connections, node/whorl rhythm or overall recognition; no new topology cost.
horsetail-cluster.ineffective_or_limited: Overall silhouette and normal-size impression are nearly unchanged. No prior defect established and no convincing advantage demonstrated.
horsetail-cluster.disposition: Retain original as default control; trial not required for quality. No additional complexity or forced randomization justified.
